aokiji89_: Wendel Aokiji came from Esterhaus, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Wendel Aokiji lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Wendel Aokiji watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Wendel Aokiji was last seen moving toward cover at Sorrow Copse. No one agrees which shelter. The report lists him as missing.
The squad at P-F8 still leaves a gap on the fire step where Wendel Aokiji used to stand.
Wendel Aokiji came back to P-F8 after sheltering with another unit. He brought a note confirming the story and a borrowed mug to return.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Wendel Aokiji aimed just below it. Casimir "Button" Gardinerryke was gravely wounded.

Wendel Aokiji rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Lucien "Spark" Darthtyronus was gravely wounded at the far edge of no man's land. Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Viktor "Button" Dominushospe stood up to sing louder, and Wendel Aokiji fired. Viktor "Button" Dominushospe was grazed. The singing stopped.
New laces made Wendel Aokiji's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
Wendel washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
boeing_b17_pilot_: After 9 days of war, S-C15 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Tobias Pilot.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Tobias Pilot shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Tobias Pilot read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Tobias Pilot is number 972. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Tobias Pilot during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Tobias Pilot shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Silas Kitty, was badly wounded.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Tobias Pilot's ear at S-C15 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Benedikt "Mole" Olliedav of the Concord (@olliedav124).
Tobias Pilot's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-C15 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
Tobias Pilot had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
Tobias Pilot was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Silas Kitty was badly wounded.
Tobias Pilot fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Benedikt "Mole" Olliedav was grazed.
Ulrich "Smokes" Sam and Tobias Pilot built a small shelf out of a cracker box. It holds two mugs, a candle and one shared hope.
dalton.cahill: On Day 9 Teodor Cahill took a post at T-S9 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He is superstitious about the number three, and the men liked him for it.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Teodor Cahill heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Teodor Cahill borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In T-S9, Teodor Cahill listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Teodor Cahill has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.
Teodor Cahill drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.
The dugout has begun inventing endings to Teodor Cahill's story. The cook's version involves an inheritance; the corporal's involves a disciplinary hearing.
The missing instalment reached Teodor Cahill. The explanation was so poor that the dugout voted to keep the cook's ending.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Teodor Cahill said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
Teodor Cahill carried duckboards up from the rear all night. His shoulders are a map of splinters.
Teodor had orders to attack at dawn. He wrote back asking for artillery first. The orders were cancelled. Nobody knows which of his words did it.
dorufotograful: Quentin Dorufotograf took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Albin Jib, gravely wounded. Quentin Dorufotograf cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Blackwater Canal has been won. Quentin Dorufotograf listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

The gun at S-S16 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Casimir "Owl" Mas, badly wounded. Quentin Dorufotograf got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 611. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Quentin Dorufotograf helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Quentin Dorufotograf hates silence more than shelling. Today, under fire at Calvary Farm, that habit was the only steady thing in S-S16.
Quentin Dorufotograf taught Severin "Crow" Boy three words in the language of home. Crow uses all three at the wrong moment, every day.

Quentin Dorufotograf felt a hard tug at his hip at S-S16. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Dorian Noahz of the Concord (@702.noahz).
The wound on Quentin Dorufotograf's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
Quentin Dorufotograf agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
The artist tried again while Quentin Dorufotograf read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
Quentin sent the portrait home after asking the artist to leave the ears alone. A photograph would have cost more than he could spare.
dougc117: The draft reached N-F11 on Day 12. Felix Dougc was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Wendel Mothrawhoisl of the Concord and Felix Dougc of the Hegemony have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at the Chalk Pits. It is getting crowded.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Felix Dougc across the shin at N-F11. It bled a lot and meant very little.
The wound on Felix Dougc's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.

Felix Dougc counted the steps of the Concord sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Konrad "Spark" Raven never saw the shovel coming. (@recon.raven14) In the dark of the Concord trench Felix Dougc hit Matthias "Tin" Kalina with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@petr.kalina_) Back from the raid, Felix Dougc found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'Wings' (legendary). Nobody asked where it came from.

A bullet found Felix Dougc at N-F11, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Ulrich Redner of the Concord (@vance_redner). Felix Dougc was hit at N-F11 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Ulrich Redner of the Concord (@vance_redner).
The papers connected Clement Dougc to Felix Dougc. The men took longer to learn Clement Dougc's own habits, but they made the effort.

At N-F11 a round went through Clement's lung. Every breath had a sound in it that the men will not forget. Shot by Casimir "Ghost" Tine of the Concord (@therealgu1ll0tine). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Clement fell at N-F11 and never moved again.
Valentin Dougc came to the front because his brother Clement Dougc never came home. He carries a tin whistle.
edwinni111: The new field cook gave his name as Benedikt Edwinni. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
The cook borrowed Benedikt Edwinni's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
Someone asked Benedikt Edwinni to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
Isidor Nult and Benedikt Edwinni tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
Benedikt Edwinni wrote a song about Lantern Hill. Florian "Smokes" Tyehawkins wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
A bullet grazed Benedikt Edwinni's ribs at N-F21. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Viktor Benb of the Hegemony (@benb0y).

A bullet found Benedikt at N-F21, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Silas Stoll of the Hegemony (@easton.stoll). Benedikt fell at N-F21 with a bullet in the head. He had been laughing a moment before.
Bastian "Owl" Edwinni joined N-F21 under the shadow of Benedikt Edwinni's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
emcfckingcann: Nils "Ghost" Emcfckingcan arrived at S-C12 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Nils "Ghost" Emcfckingcan wrote to a grandmother who prays for both armies that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Valentin Coleharrison and Nils "Ghost" Emcfckingcan made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Nils "Ghost" Emcfckingcan answered to number 702. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-C12. Nils "Ghost" Emcfckingcan has learned to walk bent double.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Nils "Ghost" Emcfckingcan. The men named it the Judge and said it had chosen him.
the Judge the crow follows Nils "Ghost" Emcfckingcan along the trench now. When the Judge flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.
Somebody in S-C12 wanted to shoot the Judge for the pot. Nils "Ghost" Emcfckingcan stood in front of the rifle. The matter has been dropped.
Nils "Ghost" Emcfckingcan sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking.
A bullet clipped Nils "Ghost" Emcfckingcan's helmet at S-C12 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Rafael "Mole" Jedrk of the Hegemony (@jedrk_123).
Nils "Ghost" Emcfckingcan's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-C12 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
Nils found a packet of seeds in a ruined house and put them in a tin of soil on the parapet at S-C12.
illegalxeno9: "You're late," said the corporal when Zeno Illegalxeno arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Zeno Illegalxeno only heard boots on the duckboards at Q-F12, then nothing but pain. Raider: Bastian Deionmurillo of the Concord (@deionmurillo). The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Zeno Illegalxeno helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Zeno Illegalxeno was hit in the hip at Q-F12. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Karel "Whistle" Damiancarril of the Concord (@damiancarrillo2003). The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Zeno Illegalxeno folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
The bearers moved Zeno Illegalxeno's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
No bed, no surgeon, just a medic with a kit and a lot of patience. Zeno Illegalxeno recovered anyway and is back at Q-F12.
Zeno Illegalxeno saw Ulrich Felix freeze up on the fire step at the Sunken Road. Zeno said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.

The last of the jam was shared by adding hot water and calling it a drink. Zeno Illegalxeno approved the method. A letter from home reached Zeno Illegalxeno before dusk. Zeno Illegalxeno read it twice and slept a little easier. The new duty roster listed Zeno Illegalxeno as a chaplain. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

Zeno Illegalxeno sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway. A thin letter reached Zeno Illegalxeno. Only five lines long, and Zeno Illegalxeno knew every one of them by heart before supper.

Zeno Illegalxeno got a letter from Josef. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. Zeno Illegalxeno read the letter out loud to the squad, skipping the private parts. The men asked to hear it again.

At Q-F12 a round caught Zeno below the ribs. He sat down slowly against the trench wall and said, quite calmly, that it hurt. Shot by Karel Izaya of the Concord (@ronin_izaya). Zeno spent the evening answering a letter. The first draft was too long. The second was too short. The third was just right.
jackalaaltosfritz: Bram Jackalaaltos, a dance-hall violinist from Esterhaus, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in U-F14. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Bram Jackalaaltos lay behind a dead tree trunk at U-F14 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Isidor Kangaroo was gravely wounded. Bram Jackalaaltos smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Karel "Shadow" Pcampbellsmi came out for a cup and was grazed. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Bram Jackalaaltos helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Across from U-F14, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Bram Jackalaaltos saw it. Matthias Landscapro was gravely wounded.
Bram Jackalaaltos spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.
Bram Jackalaaltos fired at the enemy dawn watch from U-F14. Hugo Flex was gravely wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Bram Jackalaaltos had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Pavel "Spark" Levichapman was gravely wounded.
Dawn watch. Bram Jackalaaltos put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Viktor Blacksmithsb, grazed.
Bram Jackalaaltos found an old map of Grey Mill from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them.
At the Chalk Pits, Bram and Norbert "Bones" Primum exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.
jacoby.rob55: Nobody asked Silas "Parson" Rob why he came. Nobody in N-F19 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Silas "Parson" Rob gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page. A letter from home reached Silas "Parson" Rob before dusk. Silas "Parson" Rob read it twice and slept a little easier.
Silas "Parson" Rob tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.

Silas "Parson" Rob had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Karel Ingvaldsen, grazed. A letter from home reached Silas "Parson" Rob before dusk. Silas "Parson" Rob read it twice and slept a little easier.

Silas "Parson" Rob went over the top with the night raiders, face black with soot. In the Hegemony trench a man turned around too late. Quentin Llibrecommel did not get up again. (@llibrecommellair) Silas "Parson" Rob was on the dawn watch at N-F19 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Silas "Parson" Rob was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Emil Wwtbdceo of the Hegemony (@wwtbdceo). A letter from home found Silas "Parson" Rob before the night shift. Silas "Parson" Rob folded it small and kept it close.

Silas "Parson" Rob returned to N-F19 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. The mail bag came up with the soup. There was a letter for Silas "Parson" Rob, and the soup went cold while Silas "Parson" Rob read it.

Silas shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter. There was a parcel for Silas: socks, a cake, and a note that said eat the cake first. Silas ate the cake first.
joebandilla: On Day 9 Dorian Joebandilla took a post at Q-F21 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He is superstitious about the number three, and the men liked him for it.

The Hegemony raiders came over at Q-F21 in the middle of the night. Dorian Joebandilla met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Zeno Helldiver of the Hegemony (@some_random_helldiver).
The papers say Severin Joebandilla. The sergeant says he has his brother's eyes. Dorian Joebandilla's eyes. Nobody in Q-F21 argues.

Severin Joebandilla spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Severin Joebandilla stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Frost made each footprint distinct. Severin Joebandilla followed a trail to the missing ration sack and found the quartermaster sitting on it.
Fog so thick that Severin Joebandilla could not see the end of his own rifle. Somewhere out there, someone was whistling.
Severin Joebandilla and Gustav Suppahneggah found a cat in the ruins at the Drowned Farm and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Gustav.
Severin Joebandilla dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.

Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Severin Joebandilla only heard boots on the duckboards at Q-F21, then nothing but pain. Raider: Zeno Helldiver of the Hegemony (@some_random_helldiver).
Severin Joebandilla walked back up the communication trench to Q-F21, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Severin spent the night on the fire step at Q-F21, watching a dark line that might have been a hedge.
kelvincornbread: Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr found a place in R-F17 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A recruit asked Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.

Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr and the recruit have reached whole words. Lessons take place beside the stove, with spelling corrections from people pretending not to listen. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F17 and grazed Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Jakub Virajvirxgil of the Hegemony (@virajvirxgill13).
Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
The recruit wrote a first short letter without Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr's help. He was allowed to check the envelope, but not the contents.
Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen was grazed.

Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr was on the dawn watch at R-F17 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Ivo Fous of the Hegemony (@le_photographe_fous). Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr died in the ward while the orderly was reading him a letter from home. The orderly finished the letter anyway.
The papers say Felix "Doc" Kelvincornbr. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Wendel "Mole" Kelvincornbr's eyes. Nobody in R-F17 argues.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Felix "Doc" Kelvincornbr read a theatre review while peeling supper. Felix "Doc" Kelvincornbr got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 155. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Felix "Doc" Kelvincornbr watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

The gun crews at R-F17 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Pavel Bliss was gravely wounded. Felix "Doc" Kelvincornbr was hit through the chest at R-F17. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony (@beyond_dusky_skies). Felix "Doc" Kelvincornbr was killed at R-F17 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony (@beyond_dusky_skies).
A letter came with Dorian Kelvincornbr: "I am Felix "Doc" Kelvincornbr's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Dorian Kelvincornbr fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Dorian "Brick" Bliss was grazed, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.
Dorian Kelvincornbr and Yann Vylet made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
Dorian Kelvincornbr washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Dorian Kelvincornbr was hit hard in the fight at R-F17 before anyone could fire. The raider was Marek Elox of the Hegemony. Raider: Marek Elox of the Hegemony (@gm_elox).

Dorian Kelvincornbr was hit through the stomach at R-F17. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Silas Haydengonzal of the Hegemony (@haydengonzales). Dorian Kelvincornbr was killed on watch at R-F17. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Silas Haydengonzal of the Hegemony (@haydengonzales).
Arno Kelvincornbr took the same post at R-F17 where Dorian Kelvincornbr stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Arno fired, and Isidor "Hollow" Newnario was grazed.
mount.ain220: Yann "Saint" Ain took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Yann "Saint" Ain crawled through a gap in the Concord wire and slid into their trench. Oskar Eddie reached for a rifle. Yann "Saint" Ain was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@eduard._.eddie) Blackwater Canal has been won. Yann "Saint" Ain listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Yann "Saint" Ain across the shin at R-C7. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Rafael Schildbroete of the Concord (@schildbroete). Yann "Saint" Ain got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 655. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Yann "Saint" Ain helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Yann "Saint" Ain came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
Yann "Saint" Ain made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
Yann "Saint" Ain sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
Yann "Saint" Ain and Matthias Fejobo carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.
Fresh from training, Yann "Saint" Ain still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Arno Glas, gravely wounded.
Yann "Saint" Ain fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Oskar Knightowlvt, now badly wounded.
Yann fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Casimir "Crow" Nugg was gravely wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.
nkmcnamee: Gideon Nkmcnamee arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in Q-F16 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Gideon Nkmcnamee wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at Q-F16 and grazed Gideon Nkmcnamee's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Bram Amanatidis of the Hegemony (@amanatidis511). Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Gideon Nkmcnamee stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Gideon Nkmcnamee walked back up the communication trench to Q-F16, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Gideon Nkmcnamee was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
Gideon Nkmcnamee had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Bastian Hat was grazed.
Gideon Nkmcnamee fixed the strap on Otto Taylocirapto's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.

A bullet hit Gideon Nkmcnamee's belt buckle at Q-F16 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Dietrich Drak of the Hegemony (@glauber.drak). Gideon Nkmcnamee had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Yann Thefreakones crossed it, Gideon Nkmcnamee fired. Yann Thefreakones was badly wounded.
Back on the fire step at Q-F16. Gideon Nkmcnamee says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
The water jacket hissed as Gideon fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Clement "Bones" Bear was badly wounded.
noirangelfang: Tobias Noirangelfan arrived with the evening ration party, carrying his mother's thimble and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
Tobias Noirangelfan is always the first one awake. Today, under fire at Grey Mill, that habit was the only steady thing in S-F15.

Tobias Noirangelfan borrowed a book with three readers already waiting. For once, everyone was impatient about something other than relief. Verdel Ridge has been won. Tobias Noirangelfan listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Dawn watch. Tobias Noirangelfan put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Edmund Potato, grazed.
Tobias Noirangelfan saw Wendel "Mole" Day freeze up on the fire step at the Drowned Farm. Tobias said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.

Asked what he wanted after the war, Tobias Noirangelfan said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on. From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Tobias Noirangelfan wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
The shelling stopped while Tobias Noirangelfan was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving.
Benedikt Jakubwilkuu and Tobias Noirangelfan sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
Tobias Noirangelfan thought about a teacher who said he would amount to nothing on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.
An empty jam tin became Tobias Noirangelfan's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.

Tobias Noirangelfan was on the dawn watch at S-F15 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Tobias Noirangelfan was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Albin Sem of the Hegemony (@sem0235). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Tobias Noirangelfan kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A bullet struck Tobias Noirangelfan below the ribs at S-F15. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Roland "Lucky" Huncho of the Hegemony (@llsj_9huncho). Tobias Noirangelfan was killed at S-F15 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Roland "Lucky" Huncho of the Hegemony (@llsj_9huncho).

The House of Noirangelfan sent Norbert Noirangelfan after Tobias Noirangelfan. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Norbert Noirangelfan is number 108. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Norbert Noirangelfan looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

A bullet went into Norbert Noirangelfan's chest just under the heart at S-F15. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Roland "Spark" Nothing of the Hegemony (@emir.nothing). The bearers reached Norbert Noirangelfan at S-F15 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Roland "Spark" Nothing of the Hegemony (@emir.nothing).
The papers connected Benedikt Noirangelfan to Norbert Noirangelfan. The men took longer to learn Benedikt Noirangelfan's own habits, but they made the effort.
Benedikt Noirangelfan tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
Benedikt Noirangelfan carried in young Anton, who lied about his age to enlist. young Anton kept asking whether his mother would be told.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Benedikt Noirangelfan helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Benedikt Noirangelfan was hit hard in the fight at S-F15 before anyone could fire. The raider was Walter Mat of the Hegemony. Raider: Walter Mat of the Hegemony (@civo_mat).

A bullet went through Benedikt Noirangelfan's upper arm at S-F15 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Severin Heheheha of the Hegemony (@heheheha1939).
Benedikt got well on a stretcher in the trench behind S-F15, with a canvas sheet for a roof and the squad for a nurse.
northerncountryman100: After 9 days of war, T-F3 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Gideon Northerncoun.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In T-F3, Gideon Northerncoun listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Asked what he wanted after the war, Gideon Northerncoun said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Gideon Northerncoun wrote to an old father who runs the family shop alone that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Gideon Northerncoun wrote a letter for Karel "Spark" Freejstax's mother, because Spark could not find the words. Spark signed it.
Gideon Northerncoun raised his head for a heartbeat too long at T-F3. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee of the Hegemony (@colinhydee).

Gideon Northerncoun was carrying water up to T-F3 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Gideon Northerncoun did not. Shot by Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin of the Hegemony (@halil.ibrahim.timucin). A single shot at T-F3. Gideon Northerncoun sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin of the Hegemony (@halil.ibrahim.timucin).
Tobias Northerncoun had heard about Gideon Northerncoun's courage. At T-F3, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at T-F3 and grazed Tobias Northerncoun's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Albin Kyrachanxq of the Hegemony (@_kyrachanxq).
The medics cleaned Tobias Northerncoun's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at T-F3.

Tobias Northerncoun was hit in the foot through his boot at T-F3. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Leopold "Parson" Carlosm of the Hegemony (@carlosm.jr). Tobias Northerncoun was killed at T-F3 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Leopold "Parson" Carlosm of the Hegemony (@carlosm.jr).
A letter came with Valentin "Crow" Northerncoun: "I am Tobias Northerncoun's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Valentin closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
paintbusch: Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch was a tailor in Kesselby until the posters went up. He came to T-S12 with a frozen apple, and within a day the whole squad knew that he shares cigarettes but never smokes.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-S12 with the rations. Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch ate while listening to the revised orders.

Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch wrote a song about Saint-Ash crossroads. Karel Smolders wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third. After the loss of Grey Mill, Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch helped stack spare sandbags at T-S12. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A round went through the rim of Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Tobias Cermitboy of the Hegemony (@cermitboy). An enemy patrol scattered in front of T-S12. Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch fired at the last man to run. Leopold Irl was grazed.
The medic looked at Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to T-S12. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch and Karel Smolders found a cat in the ruins at the Drowned Farm and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Karel.
A clear shot from T-S12. Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch badly wounded Bram Uselesmagika and slid back down below the parapet.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers stood up to sing louder, and Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch fired. Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers was gravely wounded. The singing stopped.
Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch and Karel Smolders share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
Ulrich had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Konrad "Whistle" Logancooke was badly wounded.
patrick.houghton.5602: The draft reached Q-F8 on Day 10. Henrik Houghton was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Henrik Houghton saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at Q-F8 and fired once. Gideon Lfie was grazed. Henrik Houghton fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Karel Mstk, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Henrik Houghton during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Henrik Houghton aimed a step ahead and fired: Gideon Lfie, gravely wounded. Henrik Houghton fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Marek Himself, now grazed.
Henrik Houghton kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
Henrik Houghton fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Valentin "Owl" Manthatsment, grazed.
A bullet hit the sandbag next to Henrik Houghton's ear at Q-F8 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Karel Mstk of the Concord (@sam_mstk13).
The medic cut the last bandage off Henrik Houghton's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to Q-F8 the same hour.

Henrik Houghton was hit in the forearm at Q-F8. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Karel Mstk of the Concord (@sam_mstk13).
Henrik is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
smhorner56: Isidor Smhorner came up with a draft of replacements on Day 13. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Isidor Smhorner lent Teodor Collinhaney a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
Isidor Smhorner saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at V-F15 and fired once. Clement "Ash" Velcic was gravely wounded.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Isidor Smhorner across the shin at V-F15. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Pavel Velcic of the Concord (@michal_velcic).
Isidor Smhorner no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
A quiet afternoon. Isidor sat on an ammunition box and watched the smoke from the stove make shapes.
smiridisnick: Zeno Smiridisnick reported to R-F15 with a bullet that missed him sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Number 82 on the early rolls: Zeno Smiridisnick. The First Wave ribbon arrived with instructions about where to sew it and no needle.
Zeno Smiridisnick spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points.
News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached R-F15 with the rations. Zeno Smiridisnick ate while listening to the revised orders.

The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Zeno Smiridisnick spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open. Zeno Smiridisnick became a sapper today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.
Machine-gun fire swept R-F15. Zeno Smiridisnick took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord (@es31230).

Zeno Smiridisnick spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Zeno Smiridisnick helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

The medics would not give up on Zeno Smiridisnick. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to R-F15 today. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno Smiridisnick. Zeno Smiridisnick read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Tobias "Smokes" Chris's name scratched on it. Zeno Smiridisnick kicked it back. It did not come again.
Norbert Bucket (Concord) and Zeno Smiridisnick (Hegemony) watched each other through the same loophole at Blackwater Canal for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.

Zeno Smiridisnick was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno Smiridisnick. Zeno Smiridisnick read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Zeno Smiridisnick shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Zeno Smiridisnick heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Zeno Smiridisnick could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Zeno Smiridisnick spent the night underground, listening. Somewhere beneath Hill 304 someone else was digging too. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno Smiridisnick. Zeno Smiridisnick read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A bullet clipped Zeno Smiridisnick's helmet at R-F15 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh of the Concord (@le.mrsh_).
Zeno Smiridisnick's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-F15 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.

The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Zeno Smiridisnick asked to see the second one. The barber laughed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno Smiridisnick. Zeno Smiridisnick read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Zeno Smiridisnick was hit hard in the fight at R-F15 before anyone could fire. The raider was Ivo "Tin" Chappell of the Concord. Raider: Ivo "Tin" Chappell of the Concord (@cooper_chappell22).

Zeno Smiridisnick walked back up the communication trench to R-F15, slower than before, but on his own feet. A letter came for Zeno Smiridisnick with a ribbon tied around it. Zeno Smiridisnick kept the ribbon in a tunic pocket.
Zeno measured a replacement beam three times in the narrow passage. Nobody wanted to be the one who got it wrong.
yahyahbouy: The quartermaster asked Matthias "Shadow" Yahyahbouy to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included. Matthias "Shadow" Yahyahbouy asked to leave the runners and serve as a stretcher bearer. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Matthias "Shadow" Yahyahbouy only heard boots on the duckboards at V-F4, then nothing but pain. Raider: Rafael "Shadow" Ahoyboihart of the Concord (@ahoyboihart). Matthias "Shadow" Yahyahbouy did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
The House of Yahyahbouy sent Ivo "Spark" Yahyahbouy after Matthias "Shadow" Yahyahbouy. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

Ivo "Spark" Yahyahbouy held the mirror while Jakub "Rabbit" Gib shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments. The letter for Ivo "Spark" Yahyahbouy was mostly about the weather at home. Ivo "Spark" Yahyahbouy read that part twice too.

Ivo opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first. A letter reached Ivo with a child's drawing of a soldier. The soldier in the drawing was smiling. Ivo tried to as well.
